CDC analyzed data from an optional module of the 2004 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) survey
BRFSS conducts annual state-based, random-digit--dialed telephone surveys of the noninstitutionalized U.S. civilian population

methods_quotes.q: All data were weighted to produce population-based estimates according to age-, race-, and sex-specific state population counts
Data were adjusted to the standard age and sex distribution of 2004 BRFSS respondents
Statistical significance was determined by pairwise linear contrasts of the estimates
The frequency of binge drinking was calculated by averaging the number of episodes reported by all binge drinkers
Analysis by state was not performed because of multiple subgroups with fewer than 50 respondents.
